form.name: signingSecret
form.label: Signing secret (required). Generate with openssl rand -hex 32.

form.name: verificationSecret
form.label: Verification secret (required). Run openssl rand -hex 32 again for a different value.

post-install.label: Open the service route and append /demo/ to try the widget. Use the verification secret only in your application backend.

For public use, enable HTTPS. Set FCAPTCHA_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES to the hostnames that embed the widget and set TRUSTED_PROXIES to the specific Cosmos proxy addresses. See the FCaptcha HARDENING.md guide.
